content: Portrait illustration of one extremely elongated fashion figure on deep crimson, with a large low-contrast dark red disk bearing black tracery, a tiny face, long neck and limbs, black-gold divisions and an asymmetrical walking pose. A few ivory curves form an empty skirt scaffold and tilted elliptical hem with the same background visible throughout; dotted pearl chains and sculptural shoes provide accents.
